sci_math.title: Science (Maths)
sci_math.subtitle: Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics (PCM)
sci_math.description: This field entails a methodical examination and exploration, employing a range of techniques like observation and experimentation. The key subjects covered in this discipline encompass physics, chemistry, and mathematics.
advantages: A strong grasp of the subject provides the potential to innovate and create new technologies.
Enhances comprehension of the occurrence of natural processes and phenomena through hypothesis formulation and experimental investigations.
sci_math.coursesTitle: Top Graduate Level Courses after 12th for PCM Students

commerce.title: Commerce
commerce.subtitle: Economics, Accountancy & Business Studies
commerce.description: Commerce, as a field of study, entails the examination of business operations and trade. The core subjects within this discipline encompass economics, accountancy, and business studies. Typically, research is not the predominant pursuit within this academic path.
advantages: It fosters a comprehensive understanding of how business activities have a direct and indirect impact on society and the economy.
It imparts the skills of recording, categorizing, and interpreting financial records and monetary transactions, essential for effective financial management.
commerce.coursesTitle: Top Graduate Level Courses after 12th for Commerce Students

sci_bio.title: Science (Bio)
sci_bio.subtitle: Physics, Chemistry & Biology (PCB)
sci_bio.description: Biology is the scientific discipline focused on the examination of life and living organisms, encompassing their anatomy, physiology, development, and evolutionary processes. It elucidates the mechanisms underlying the survival of living entities.
advantages: Providing insights and knowledge that can be applied to enhance healthcare systems and preventive strategies for diseases and health-related challenges.
Offering a vast realm for scientific research, actively encouraged by both government and private sectors, with significant opportunities for advancements.
sci_bio.coursesTitle: Top Graduate Level Courses after 12th for PCB Students

humanities.title: Humanities
humanities.subtitle: Arts, History, Psychology & Social Sciences
humanities.description: Humanities, often referred to as the Arts, can be defined as the exploration of the 'Human Condition.' It enables a deeper understanding of human society, ideologies, beliefs, and how they manifest through artistic expressions, architecture, and religions.
advantages: Providing ample research opportunities in fields like sociology and psychology.
humanities.coursesTitle: Top Graduate Level Courses after 12th for Arts Students

TEST_SECTIONS.name: DATA & PRACTICAL ANALYSIS
TEST_SECTIONS.milestoneDesc: Take a deep breath and solve these practical, numerical, and scientific problem-solving questions.

questions.text: A publishing house printed a book with total costs of $50,000. Costs breakdown: Advertising = 40%, Author Earnings = 20%, Printing = 30%, Transport = 10%. How much money was spent on Advertising and Author Earnings respectively?

A college refund policy states: '1st year students get 100% refund; 2nd year get 50%; 3rd year get 0%'. Records show:
2008: 1st yr got 100%
2009: 2nd yr got 100%
2010: 3rd yr got 0%
2012: 2nd yr got 100%
Which TWO years broke the refund policy rules?
What is the name of the galaxy that contains our Solar System?
Which of the following is an example of a chemical change?
Ajay wants to exchange a single $500 note into $10 notes at the bank. How many $10 notes will he receive?

What is 1/9 converted into a percentage?

Circuit Logic: In a simple series electric circuit containing 3 open switches and 1 bulb, how many switches MUST be closed for the light bulb to turn on?

On Day 1, a shopkeeper sold 1 kg of rice for $40. On Day 2, he sold 1 kg of rice for $60. If he made a profit of $10 on both days, what was his buying cost (cost price) on Day 1 and Day 2 respectively?
